ai.summary: A 28-year-old labourer from Kokernag went missing in September 2026 and was found dead in Amritsar with blunt-force injuries; PDP leader Mehbooba Mufti called for a time-bound probe into his death, while local activists demanded accountability for the case.

facts.claim: A 28-year-old youth from Kokernag went missing on September 23
facts.quote: Aijaz Ahmed Dar, a labourer and resident of Halpora village in Kokernag, went missing on September 23.

facts.claim: His body was recovered in Amritsar on October 28
facts.quote: His body was recovered in Amritsar on October 28

facts.claim: The autopsy report recorded multiple blunt-force injuries
facts.quote: The autopsy report, accessed by Greater Kashmir recorded a head wound, skull fracture, bleeding beneath the scalp and brain damage, besides bruising to the left chest wall and injury to the left lung.

facts.claim: Mehbooba Mufti called for a time-bound investigation
facts.quote: Mehbooba called for a time-bound investigation and urged the Punjab Police and Union Home Ministry to ensure that those responsible were identified and punished.

facts.claim: Local activists demanded a thorough investigation
facts.quote: Local PDP leader and tribal activist Chaudhary Talib Hussain, who has been leading a campaign seeking justice for the family, questioned the Amritsar Police's handling of the case.
